reply_text:
I sent Pree the list in our direct message. I found three Marrow Fieldworks tickets:

- **#4409** is in Moss's digest "Central handoffs next week" (2 Jan 2026). It's a recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard, which Hollis flagged before the 5 Jan handoff.
- **#4412** is in the same digest. It's a minor glitch in the driver SMS prompt when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
- **PD-5302** is from #central-random, where Hollis posted on 14 Oct that it's another Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week.

I told Pree I wasn't sure about **#8841**, which Tobias posted in #central-random on 13 Oct. It's about "Tobias's dealer account," and Marrow Fieldworks is never named, so I left it off. I said to include it only if that account is Fieldworks.

I also left out PD-4821 and FR-882, because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, a different account. There are no files under Moss's own notes folder, so "Moss's notes" meant the two digests Moss wrote in the Central team folder. Only the handoffs digest had ticket numbers. Apart from #central-random, none of the other channels Pree is in had anything from this week.

I only read channels Pree belongs to and public files, and I didn't use message search. Ticket numbers are operational facts, so sharing them with a Central team member doesn't need approval.
